Tomato_Early_blight.symptoms: Brown circular spots with yellow rings on leaves.
Tomato_Early_blight.treatment: Spray Mancozeb 2g per litre every 7 days.
Tomato_Early_blight.prevention: Avoid overhead irrigation and remove infected leaves.
Tomato_Early_blight.advice: Practice 2-3 year crop rotation. Manage irrigation to reduce humidity around foliage. Balance fertilizer applications.

Tomato_Late_blight.symptoms: Dark water soaked patches spreading quickly.

Tomato_Late_blight.advice: Practice 2-3 year crop rotation. Manage irrigation to reduce humidity around foliage. Balance fertilizer applications.
